meta_description: High Gear Towing serving Hamilton Township - towing that shows up when you call.
h1_emph: Towing in Hamilton Township from people who answer the phone.
hero_lede: Towing in Hamilton Township. Recent jobs are on the photos page.
explore_h2: Stuck, stranded, or off the road
card_about: Who you are calling, and the work we do in Hamilton Township.
coverage_h2: Also serving the towns around Hamilton Township
footer_blurb: High Gear Towing serving Hamilton Township.
about_p1: Our work covers motorcycle transport, winch-out and recovery, roadside assistance, and accident recovery for drivers who need it done right.
about_p2: We work out of Hamilton Township and the towns around it.
area_h2: We work in and around Hamilton Township
svc_hero_h1: The towing work we take on

services.title: Motorcycle transport
services.body: Bikes go on the deck with soft ties and a wheel chock so nothing is clamped to a frame or a fork that was never meant to take it.
services.alt: A long nose heavy wrecker rigged to a tipper on soft ground

evidence.text: A motorcycle strapped upright on the deck with the wheel chocked

services.title: Winch-out and recovery
services.body: If it has come off the road or dropped a wheel, we run the line out and bring it back up before anything is loaded.
services.alt: A pressure vessel loaded on the trailer and secured for the road

evidence.text: A burnt out vehicle recovered from the verge with the crew working the line

services.title: Roadside assistance
services.body: A jump, a tire swap, a lockout or a can of fuel gets handled at the shoulder when that is all the car actually needs.
services.alt: The rotator set up with the boom out and the outriggers down

evidence.text: A camper van loaded on the deck at the roadside

services.title: Accident recovery
services.body: After a wreck the car is cleared from the scene, loaded without doing more damage, and taken where you or your insurer want it.
services.alt: A saloon loaded on the deck out on the highway

evidence.text: A heavy wrecker rigged to a tipper out on the carriageway

services.title: Car and light truck transport
services.body: Cars, pickups and vans ride flat on the deck and are chained at the points the manufacturer put there for it.
services.alt: A box truck carried on the deck through the yard

evidence.text: A box truck carried on the deck through the yard

gallery.alt: A camper van loaded on the deck at the roadside
A heavy wrecker in red and white with the underlift stowed

A box truck loaded on the deck and squared up ready to move
A fifties classic winched gently up onto the deck

reviews.author: Lori Pantaleo
reviews.text: Not only were the employees of High Gear Towing friendly, they were also very helpful. I had not had to deal with an accident that totalled my car before this week. The folks at High Gear provided me with a lot of information I had not gotten from my insurance company. I am very grateful for their valuable assistance!

reviews.author: Allison Viola
reviews.text: What an amazing company! The dispatcher Jessica was efficient and honest with incredible customer service skills! Jason was the driver who was excellent! His professionalism and kindness was reassuring in a very stressful situation! Im so grateful for calling this company!!

reviews.author: Sandra Herrington
reviews.text: I needed to move a vintage car that currently does not run, from my old house to new house. High gear was amazing. The weather caused me to reschedule a couple times. Everyone over at High Gear is great. Dispatch was so accommodating and understanding. Our driver did a superb job navigating two long narrow drives. I didn’t catch his name, but he was just so careful with my vehicle. Highly recommend for both scheduled and emergency towing needs. It’s no surprise why their reviews are so good.

reviews.author: Alan Zahn (NJLOCOMAN)
reviews.text: High Gear towing was the company that was dispatched by my insurance towing service. I was so pleasantly surprised that they showed up SO FAST! The driver Immer was helpful and friendly! The service was SO FAST! Thank you!

reviews.author: Malik Stridiron
reviews.text: Very good ppl … just needed a battery jump for a 26’ box truck in the freezing cold and they came to the rescue …. prices were “Extremely Reasonable” especially as it relates to the previous company I contacted whilst being located immediately across the street from the establishment my truck was parked …. the dispatcher was very nice, helpful, and overall friendly as well, wish I could remember her name to take the opportunity to show her appreciation for her work … she was very professional and I hope this message reaches her anyways … overall I believe this company is very well deserving of the pristine reputation and 5 star status … driver was cool and professional as well … salute to you guys her/him and the rest of the crew/company, I rarely leave reviews so definitely impressed with your service

reviews.author: Jacquie Williams
reviews.text: Fast and friendly service and professional as well. Kept me informed about ETA, called when they were closer to the time and told me what they needed to do. My car was towed to the dealership, I was able to ride along in the warm truck and had great conversation.

reviews.author: Paul
reviews.text: Amazing and quick service! Kevin got to me on the side of the road in record time and went above and beyond with his service. I highly recommend using high gear towing!

reviews.author: Patcharin Anantawarasin
reviews.text: My truck broke down on 95 S New Brunswick Parkway. Long story short…some tow truck company got me off the highway safely and left my truck at their garage. Next morning I called to assigned another tow truck to take the truck for a service and Jason came to a rescue, he was very nice, and kind…as we traveled to the auto shop for the service I received a call from the shop that there won’t be a mechanic working today…soonest will be tomorrow. Unfortunately I live an hour away from there and I need the truck and can’t wait till tomorrow so Jason said “I will tow you wherever you want me to”, that save my day. Jason and High Gear towing can just do their job as the insurance assigned them to and leave me there but they welling to go an inch longer for me. So I want to say Thank you to Jason and High Gear Towing for took good care of me and my truck. Safe and sounds.

reviews.author: Christine M
reviews.text: Great experience all around, from point of contact, to pick up, to meticulous care of my vehicle during loading and unloading. Job Well Done and Thank You!

reviews.author: Jefferson Alvarez
reviews.text: I highly recommend High Gear! Not only were they very nice and respectful they also did their best to help me. I will continue to use them in the future. Thank you guys!

reviews.author: Bryan Scheff
reviews.text: Excellent service! Fast response and willingness to go the extra step to do the job right! Hope to never need a tow again, but if I do it's High Gear all the way!

reviews.author: Andre Wooley
reviews.text: They will pick you up on the highway and take you where you need to go. Great service and would use again. Trusted them with my Benz and handled the job well.

reviews.author: Brian Cocchi
reviews.text: Called them for tow today. Customer service was great. Driver was there fast. Driver was very friendly. Definitely recommend this place.

reviews.author: J Harmon
reviews.text: Fast response. Driver was very professional & friendly. He did the hookup, tow & drop off with care. (As if it was his own car!). Took the extra time to prepare his equipment for the next tow. Would definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Donna Boston
reviews.text: I wish I could give more than five stars!! I was stuck for hours. No other towing company could help me but High Gear came through. I’m from out of town and didn’t know who to call. I wish I had called High Gear first it would’ve saved me so much trouble. Both the receptionist who took my call, and the driver who helped me, were excellent in their commitment to good service. I don’t very often do reviews online, but this company deserves it!

reviews.author: Twist
reviews.text: Had my car impounded here in February, but they were incredibly pleasant and cordial then. Worked with me and got my car back, so I took note and decided if I ever needed a personal tow I would give them a call. Unfortunately my truck broke down today on my way to work, so I did just what I said I would and got a quote. Decided on the spot that was probably my best bet and i dont rescind my decision. Immer was a cordial and respectful man. 10/10 if i ever need another recovery for one of my vehicles I cant do myself, high gear is on my speed dial

reviews.author: Donna Swisher
reviews.text: Jason was extremely helpful and knowledgeable regarding our issue. He got us to our preferred auto shop safe and sound. He went over and beyond to help us, it was extremely appreciated.

reviews.author: Mookie
reviews.text: Got on the phone and asked a very simple towing question I had, that I by that point called 8 other towing companies to ask the exact same question (Was calling different locations to gauge price differences). The lady on the phone was the first person to catch an attitude and talk smart with me in a condescending manner, saying "You need to go to Google and blah blah blah" as if I hadn't been doing that exact thing the past hour, when all she had to say was "Sorry, we are unable to because your location is too far." Mind you, they were one of the closer places we called relatively and others much farther away still offered their services.

reviews.author: Bianca Scott
reviews.text: High Gear towing was very helpful and speedy! Pricing was perfect. The dispatcher was a nice lady who really makes you feel well taken care of. Jason was very efficient and get the job done with no issues. I appreciate you both for saving the day!

reviews.author: Ramona Chell
reviews.text: The tow truck driver (Alfredo) was kind and extremely helpful! He arrived very quickly and went above and beyond in his roadside and customer service! During a challenging time when my car wouldn’t start, HE got it started! (Not the AAA service mechanic) Due to his skills and experience, I didn’t get my car towed! I’m very grateful. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Abby Fennimore
reviews.text: Jim was a fantastic driver. He was kind and positive during the entire experience of getting my vehicle towed. The process was quick and easy. He even texted me to let me know when it was dropped off. Excellent service all around.

reviews.author: Donna Toomer
reviews.text: The driver was kind,friendly and work quickly to tow my truck away. Smooth sailing.Would highly recommended . 5 stars

reviews.author: Aimee Kaiser
reviews.text: We can’t say enough about Jim and what a wonderful experience we had with him. He was kind and informative, with a great personality and showed so much patience with us when my Insurance company was causing a glitch. After our long and stressful day, Jim’s energy and expertise put us at ease. He was very professional and courteous, and the dispatch woman was very kind and helpful as well. It was a complex tow as our wheels were locked, but Jim worked his magic and made it look easy! I would highly recommend this company and Jim. They have a real family type of feel. Thank you again!

reviews.author: chase garland
reviews.text: I so much Appreciate Justin, Jess and the High Hear family for getting me back home in a timely and professional manner. Had to get towed from Nj back to PA and not only was it a feasible charge it was a FLAT RATE with no hidden charges. The ride was smooth and I was made to feel comfortable and less stressed the whole ride . If I had to I would definitely use their services again and tell a friend!!

reviews.author: Epic Avocado
reviews.text: From the lady who had the tow truck come out, to the tow truck drivers, 100% professionalism, super nice and cordial. They towed my car from nj to pa with absolutely no problem and relatively cheap. 10/10 would not only use them again but I’d recommend them. They are a 5/5 stars for a reason and they showed why.

reviews.author: John D. Beck Jr.
reviews.text: Excellent and speedy reliable service. Office woman that handles call’s courteous, and efficient. Tow truck driver was outstanding and very knowledgeable. He also was a mechanic and allowed me to drive with him to my dealership for the repair. As a result, I have found myself a new mechanic. 5 star all the way

reviews.author: Ava Schiaffino
reviews.text: We had a flat tire, and the wrench that was provided by ford, didn’t fit lug nuts. Bordentown PD called High Gear for us. The gentleman graciously helped us. Top notch service. Thank you.

reviews.author: Tonto Johnston
reviews.text: My driver was very nice and caring. We had great conversation during our 40 minutes to our destination. It was nice to come in contact with such a nice young man during the stress of car trouble

reviews.author: Cheyenne Rosario
reviews.text: My husband had to get his truck towed this morning and Justin from High Gear Towing was sent out to him. Rather than having to get his truck towed to his mechanic in Northern NJ, Justin was able to fix a Valve that had went bad right on the spot, saving my husband both time and money. Justin was a great help & honestly a life saver. 10/10 would recommend again.

reviews.author: Karan Peterla
reviews.text: We used High Gear Towing for the first time tonight - we hope we don’t need a tow again, but if we do we’re definitely calling High Gear! The office was great to work with! They were very accommodating, explained the process, gave us helpful tips on getting paperwork from the police (the car was hit), had very affordable pricing, and provided such prompt pick-up service! The driver, Carlos, was fantastic! He arrived quickly, was very professional & friendly, and was very careful loading and unloading the vehicle. Thanks for taking some of the stress out of a stressful situation!

reviews.author: Jose Bueno
reviews.text: Amazing customer service. As soon as I called them late at night, they responded quickly. Jim showed up immediately with his truck and very understanding of my situation (first time ever needing a tow truck). Jim was very knowledgeable and helped me arrive to my home safely. I would highly recommend there services for anybody in need of help.

reviews.author: Abbi
reviews.text: After my car would not start, we had to get it towed to the local shop. Wasn't sure if it was the battery or the starter or something else altogether. Jim from High Gear in Hamilton came out and was super friendly and informative. He was prompt and helpful! He was able to tell me my battery was fully charged. Somehow my car did start and he drove it up onto the truck and went to RW Tire with my car and dropped it off. Everything was very easy and smooth and he was great! Thanks Jim!!

reviews.author: Sivakumar Natarajan
reviews.text: It took longer than what the dispatcher promised. But the truck driver Jim was great, he communicated his eta 15 mins before the arrival and very helpful and professional. Jim saved me a trip as he was able to tow my car to the dealership without me riding along with him and dropped the keys in promptly on behalf of me. Car was safely dropped off. Thanks for the great service.

reviews.author: Leon LaBella
reviews.text: Can't say enough about High Gear Towing. Justin was outstanding from start to finish. Needed a car transported same day no problem. Alfredo picked up vehicle within an hour. Car was transported and delivered. Alfredo was kind, friendly, professional, very cordial. Will use High Gear Towing for all future towing and transporting. Thanks again to Justin and Alfredo.

reviews.author: Brooke Thompson
reviews.text: Found High Gear a few years back and they have been incredible since day 1! Their team is amazing. Their drivers are friendly. They take my company's best interest to mind and make us feel like a priority every time we call! As much as it's never so fun to have a fleet vehicle down (we have multiple box trucks between 20-26' and High Gear handles them all) and get a tow, High Gear really knows how to make the best of it. The rates are fair and the service is absolutely superior. The tow trucks come quickly and get the job done professionally with safe equipment. We couldn't ask for more, High Gear is top notch!

reviews.author: Taylor Madison
reviews.text: The driver Jim was excellent! He called me personally and updated me on his location and came very quickly. He made great conversation on the way to AAA. I left my wallet in the tow truck and he even called me to let me know that he had it even though he was all the way in Pennsylvania. He told me he was going to drop it off at the shop, was there when I retrieved it. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Preeti Singh
reviews.text: Steven came out in less than the 90 minute window and was even able to get my car jump started (something the previous guy wasn’t able to do). He took me and my car to the car shop. Super pleasant, helpful and efficient. The best part of my lousy day!!

reviews.author: Janelle Fuller
reviews.text: Carlos was the driver that helped me. He was extremely friendly and explained everything that was happening and what steps I needed to take after the jump start. I am very happy with the service I received, especially after dealing with two terrible services before getting dispatched to High Gear. I would definitely recommend their service. I was connected to them through HondaCare, but if you need a reliable road side service, look no further.

reviews.author: susan fisher
reviews.text: Followed directions and kept me informed every step of the way. I had absolutely no reason to be nervous. Jim was very helpful as I was not with my vehicle. Would recommend and use again if need arises

reviews.author: Kate E. Fylstra
reviews.text: Jim was great. He called to double-check the address, which was good because my Allstate app's GPS had me somewhere completely different! He was quick, helped me figure things out, and even offered to drop me off somewhere else to wait for my ride (did I mention this was all on a Sunday afternoon?) Thank you High Gear for taking care of me at a very stressful time!

reviews.author: Danielle Williams
reviews.text: Jim from High Gear Towing was Absolutely Wonderful!! From start to finish! He was Prompt, Friendly, Helpful, Courteous and most importantly Professional!! He was gentle with my car and got it to my home safely and secure!! He called and let me know his every move from ETA, to location to arrival! Please, Please hit him up for all your Towing Needs!!!! Well done Jim!! Thank you again!

reviews.author: Kimberly Owens
reviews.text: Our tow truck driver was very helpful and calm. He reassured me that my vehicle would be delivered to the repair shop. I wish I got his name but he was the best. He kept me informed on his location and how long it would take him to get to me.

reviews.author: Jack Kiczales
reviews.text: Jim was great, friendly and really helpful - my car was so dead that it couldn't even be put into neutral and he worked hard (and a long time in the cold!) to get it up on the truck. He also drove me to the body shop and we had good conversation. I felt safe and secure the whole time.

reviews.author: Michael Bognar
reviews.text: Great service! High Gear Towing is well organized, and they dispatched a recovery driver to my location, soon after I called them. I would recommend High Gear Towing, and I would not hesitate to call them again!

reviews.author: chris
reviews.text: Hit a pothole that popped 2 tires in Wrightstown and their driver Jim showed up in 15 minutes! Gave me a call on his way and was very pleasant for the whole experience. Very accommodating and the service was great too. In the snow! Definitely will keep their auto repair shop in mind for future reference.

reviews.author: Matt Kotsovolos
reviews.text: They did a great job of keeping me updated on the status and arrived promptly. Jim the tower was great to work with. Thankfully, I’ve only had a few tows in my lifetime, but this one was the best! Would definitely recommend to a friend.

reviews.author: Darshan Nahar
reviews.text: Jim is a great tow truck driver. He called to let us know he was on the way and estimated arrival time. His services were to our complete satisfaction. He is nice guy, very helpful and great at conversation. Thank you Jim!

reviews.author: Heather Tye
reviews.text: The driver Jim came lightening fast within 3 mins from AAA to fix my tire. Great service super friendly. He went above and beyond. If you need someone ask for him. He’s great!!!! Btw congratulations on your future! Enjoy it. Say hello to Mom for us!!

reviews.author: Jamie Bowers
reviews.text: When our insurance company left us high and dry at midnight on the side of 295, High Gear Towing (literally) came to the rescue. Even tho' we disturbed our driver from a good night's sleep, he could not have been more professional or gracious. Thank you, High Gear Towing.

reviews.author: Dee Lewis
reviews.text: Stellar service! I locked myself out of my vehicle unexpectedly and within 10 minutes Jim the hero saved the day!! He flew into action, found me in the parking deck, and in literal moments had my car open again. He was also friendly pleasant and efficient. So grateful!

reviews.author: Lyhanna Lopez
reviews.text: Jim was phenomenal. Quick and reliable. He called me regardless of the information related to him by OnStar just to be more than certain that my vehicle was where they mentioned and the drop off location was correct. Which it was not. Unsure now about the OnStar service I pay for. But service from Jim...PRICELESS.

reviews.author: Carmen Soto
reviews.text: High Gear Towing was amazing! The customer service I received from Jim was great!! I was told it would be possibly an hour and they were here within 10 minutes! Friendly tow truck driver and he was even was successful at starting my car who’s battery was completely dead!!! Amazing service highly recommended!!!

reviews.author: Victor Broccoli
reviews.text: Dispatcher and driver were very friendly and professional. Truck was clean, ride was great. I hope I don’t need them again, but if I do I know I’ll be in great hands.

reviews.author: des myles
reviews.text: Justin was amazing, very professional and knowledgeable, gave advice on how to fix the truck even though I didn’t use their mechanical services. They will work with your schedule and was very affordable. Thanks for your service.

reviews.author: Daniel Bridge
reviews.text: Jim was phenomenal! Had to have my car towed after one of my pulleys seized and I lost my serpentine belt. He was really friendly and made sure to let me know when he had dropped off my vehicle.

reviews.author: Peter Leva
reviews.text: Jim was awesome. If you are unfortunately in need of a tow, these guys are one of the best. Got a flat on my home tonight. Jim picked me up quickly. Dropped me off And was very accommodating. Great conversation too

reviews.author: Shrike Zandor
reviews.text: Thanks for the quick and friendly service! I was out on a motorcycle ride and was stopped by a dead battery miles from home. Jim with High Gear Towing was called and was friendly and efficient. I made it home with no problems. Thanks for the great service Jim.

reviews.author: Y. Kats
reviews.text: Had my first tow experience and it couldn’t have been any easier. The driver Tom helped my son and I get home safe and was able to get my car in my garage as well. Tom let me know ETA and got to my location at the time he said he would. Very kind and friendly! Thanks again Tom!

reviews.author: Davion Irving
reviews.text: I can truly say high gear showed a lot concern and patients, they was very respectful and understanding. they truly came in a timely manner and the young gentleman name Tom or something like that was very respectful showed a lot of concern and made sure he helped me any way he could..THANKS HIGH GEAR

reviews.author: Liz Mitchell
reviews.text: He was punctual! He called to let me know he was finished with his last job and was on his way to me. My car battery had died so he jumped it and then dropped it off at my mechanic shop promptly. He was very pleasant!

reviews.author: Claudia
reviews.text: It was really quick response. AAA told that it will be @ 2 hours waiting time. But driver Jim came in 10 min. He is very professional and friendly. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Lucy Melvin-Grady
reviews.text: I had to have my car towed today. As upsetting as that was the experience I had with the tow driver and the tow made things better. My driver Ralph was extremely pleasant and so polite!! He made it to me in no time, I couldn't have had a better experience. I absolutely recommend. Thank you so much!!

reviews.author: Jennifer Day
reviews.text: High Gear Towing is tops in customer service! Thomas, my tow truck driver kept in touch with me, letting me know how far he was from me etc. He was friendly and quick. I felt well cared for after Thomas called me to let me know my car was delivered safely!

reviews.author: John LaRow
reviews.text: Jim was friendly and really helpful. I asked for some special attention as my window would not close (electronic problems) and he worked with the garage get the car stored in a work bay to keep it dry and secure. Thanks Jim!

reviews.author: Loki Pro
reviews.text: After being lied to and stranded for over two hours by another service, I luckily called High Gear Towing! They came within 15 minutes! Jim, the driver, couldn't have been more courteous and professional. I will definitely call them first if I ever need their services again!

reviews.author: Louis Clark
reviews.text: Extremely prompt service. Very courteous. The driver Rich was extra careful and treated my car as his own. Superior knowledge of how to tow a car correctly. This was the best tow I’ve ever experienced. Thanks Rich and High Gear Towing.

reviews.author: Jaden Gwin
reviews.text: Jimmy was prompt and very nice. Estimated time of arrival for tow was 60 minutes, he came in half hour! Was very friendly and would highly recommend to ask for him if in need for a tow!!

reviews.author: Cory Minto
reviews.text: Great, no-nonsense towing company. Jim was more than accommodating - and he was able to leave my large van in a difficult parking spot, after-hours at the shop. Really professional and courteous. 5stars.

reviews.author: yamilete lorenzo
reviews.text: Would highly recommend high gear towing company. After waiting 7 hours for my insurance company to send over a tow truck, I decided to call state police and encountered high gear towing company! The process was fast, employees are very kind and helpful. I would recommend High Gear towing company to those who want fast and kind service!

reviews.author: Michael G
reviews.text: Tom Stern got me out out of a jam when my bike wouldn’t start. Came quick, hooked it up securely & dropped it off at my requested location in a reasonable amount of time. Definitely 5 stars!

reviews.author: Robert
reviews.text: He came to the designated location and was extremely helpful with getting my car back to my house. He even went as far as assisting with the problem and identifying it so we could show up at our mechanic and have it taken care of faster.

reviews.author: megan flanner
reviews.text: It was the first time using the service. It was freezing outside and dark, but the representative was pleasant and professional. His name is Steve V he was great!! Thank you!!

reviews.author: Kelly Rogers
reviews.text: I used them today for the first time today, everything was perfect right from when I first made the call to the tow trucker drive, very friendly helpful and just overall I am soo happy I chose to use them! The price was also very very reasonable!

reviews.author: Shanique Nembhard
reviews.text: Tow truck driver was very friendly, patient and courteous. He did everything possible to ease my worries. Thank you for your kind assistance.

reviews.author: Brij Patel
reviews.text: Wheel came off my car on route 130, called AAA and tow truck never showed up on designated time and they attempted again with the same result... I was stranded past 2:00 in the morning... luckily high gear towing guy was on the road and he helped me tow my car to the garage. The guy(Tom stern) was extremely polite and helpful.

reviews.author: tania faison
reviews.text: I did not catch the drivers name but he was friendly and courteous. He arrived only 15 minutes after my call to AAA. Very satisfied!

reviews.author: J English
reviews.text: After waiting for hours for 2 other tow companies, High Gear Towing came to the rescue. They were very efficient and communicated the time of their arrival and followed through as promised. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Ganesh Gopal
reviews.text: They gave us a total price as opposed to hourly rate that was what we wanted. Justin the driver gave us a heads up before reaching the destination. Job well done ! Good company to do business with.

reviews.author: Marissa Buffa
reviews.text: High gear towing is amazing. They helped me twice this weekend due to different car issues ! They were able to tow me within a reasonable amount of time ! Justin was able to fix the issue that day for a reasonable price ! I would recommend them to everyone in the area !!

reviews.author: Brian & Abbey
reviews.text: Nothing like having someone show up to the rescue on Sunday night of a holiday weekend. Huge thanks to Jim and High Gear Towing for saving the day. Stayed in communication the whole time and arrived in the quoted time frame. Even added air to our spare tire, which saved us a future headache. Couldn't ask for more!

reviews.author: david k
reviews.text: I was in another state but Alex kept in touch the entire time. And he was ahead if schedule. He also said that he would hand my keys over to my mechanic!!! This was something that AAA would not commit to. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Talha Öcal
reviews.text: My driver was steve dulo is a very understanding, trustworthy and good at his job, I definitely recommend him.

reviews.author: Veronica Walker
reviews.text: Car broke down in Pennsylvania had to be towed to New York City. Driver was very helpful. courteous and friendly. Got us home safely.Would recommend company to family and friends.

reviews.author: Rita Poss
reviews.text: This company was great and came quickly after AAA dropped the ball by not securing the first company and not advising me of such. The team is very personable and professional.

reviews.author: Steve Savino
reviews.text: Unfortunately a Deer jumped in front of my motorcycle & ruined my morning. But I was fortunate Tom Stern, received the call, let me know when he had my bike & when he delivered my Bike before the closing time of my Garage. Thank you for professionalism!

reviews.author: Amanda Carmignani
reviews.text: They came to tow my car. I didn’t have to wait long. They called me when they got to the dealership to make sure they were leaving the car at the right spot. Would definitely use their service again.

reviews.author: sweetsramust
reviews.text: High Gear LLC towed my car they were fast and professional Tom was my tow guy thanks again Tom for the wonderful service. We really appreciate service like this he is a great guy.

reviews.author: GMG Express, Inc.
reviews.text: Justin is a good and honest guy,did a difficult clean up and a tow for us .Fair cost for the time he put into it A+

reviews.author: Harish Adithya Kuruba
reviews.text: Chris was extremely professional and courteous. Fantastic service with tracking information of the tow made available. I highly recommend High Gear Towing for everyone's road side assistance needs.

reviews.author: Kay Man
reviews.text: Jim..auto driver picked me up and got to me to the shop within 45 minutes. Aaa said it would be 2 hours. Great Job Jim the driver at High Gear Towing

reviews.author: Brandon Leaver
reviews.text: Very fast service. This was my first flat tire and Jim was very nice and took great care with my brand new car. I highly recommend High Gear Towing!

reviews.author: Alison Mazukewicz
reviews.text: Jim from High Gear Towing towed our truck to be repaired. He was very professional and friendly. He quickly loaded our truck on the flatbed. Thanks, Jim!

reviews.author: Joanne Stewart
reviews.text: Needed to have my son's truck towed from Bordentown to Ewing. Jim came and was very professional and courteous. He got the truck hooked up in no time. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Bhargavi Shah
reviews.text: Jim from High Gear towing was our hero yesterday. Many thanks for coming to our rescue on a frigid night. Awesome service and updates on where our car was dropped off.

reviews.author: Dave Stimon
reviews.text: Great response time! Was quoted an hour by Allstate and they showed up in less than 30 minutes! I was very impressed and the driver was extremely courteous and professional!

reviews.author: Jose Colon
reviews.text: Jim came out really quick, toons some pics and had my car towed in no time. Even though the weather was not great. Friendly, highly Recommend!!!

reviews.author: Keith Ingling
reviews.text: Alex and Kwame were absolutely incredible. They responded immediately, were extremely professional and incredibly knowledgeable. Great guys - highly recommend.

reviews.author: jude curini
reviews.text: I called Mercedes Benz Roadside assistance and they sent Jim from High Gear Towing he was very prompt and early to arrive and was very helpful. I would recommend High Gear for any automotive needs.

reviews.author: Jorge Colon
reviews.text: The gentleman who came to secure our front tire strap for our vehicle while en route to Florida was absolutely wonderful. Justin, you are a life saver. Thank you and God bless!!

reviews.author: Sabrina Finnegan
reviews.text: My mom's car was dead and she called this company for the first time ever. She had a driver named Axel that she was very impressed with, she said he was the nicest tow truck driver and he was very helpful.

reviews.author: Robert Paccillo
reviews.text: High Gear Towing arrived as agreed, on time. The driver for High Gear was excellent in every way. He was courteous, respectful and understanding. I would recommend High Gear Towing again.

reviews.author: sharon martini
reviews.text: Tom arrived to tow my car. He was courteous, pleasant and very professional. Would definately recommend High Gear Towing. I'd give them 5 stars.

reviews.author: Mike Vargo
reviews.text: Jim from high gear towing showed up 40 minutes EARLY to my tow and was great to chat with while he loaded up, very experienced and felt safe trusting him with my truck.

reviews.author: Larry Braasch
reviews.text: Quick response time and great service from Jim. Roadside assist said it would take 75 minutes for a tow, but Jim was there within 10 minutes.

reviews.author: Andrew Pop
reviews.text: Alex was quick and efficient in towing my car. Took no time at all for the wait or drive. If I break down again will definitely be the first I call. Thank you Alex!

reviews.author: Sonya Roberts
reviews.text: The driver was there much sooner thN expected. He was kind and courteous and did his best to make me feel comfortable. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Jacob Lemen
reviews.text: We had Jim come out and tow our Jeep Cherokee that had a dead battery and could not get into the car. He was very professional and knew what he was doing. He made it a very painful evolution. Thanks Jim!

reviews.author: Rick White
reviews.text: Outstanding Customer Service, fast response, very curtisous and profficinal. Thank you all for your help when I needed a tow. I will recommend High Gear Towing to anyone that needs a tow truck, flatbed or big rig tow truck they have it all. Thank you..Great Job!!

reviews.author: Karyn Malinowski
reviews.text: Jim was communicative, very knowledgeable and thorough . I would recommend this service in a heartbeat . Nothing is worse than needing roadside assistance on a Sunday.

reviews.author: Enrique Maron
reviews.text: Quick and efficient, my morning started off pretty rough by getting into an accident. Using high gear towing just made things less worrisome and helped reassure that things could always be worse haha but excellent service and great people skills.

reviews.author: David Brown
reviews.text: After Charlie Allen's Towing stranded me, High Gear was dispatched, and was there in 20 minutes. Driver communicated, was friendly and super helpful. Thanks much!
